title: Additivity of the expectation operator
statement:
Fix $n \in \bbn$ and a coordinate direction $i \in \{1,\dots,n\}$, and write $E_i$ for the expectation operator in direction $i$, which sends a Boolean function $h : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ to the function $(E_i h)(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}\bigl(h(x^{i\mapsto 0}) + h(x^{i\mapsto 1})\bigr)$. Then $E_i$ is additive: for all Boolean functions $f, g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$,
\[
  E_i(f + g) = E_i f + E_i g.
\]
hypotheses_covered: Boolean functions f, g of arity n
replaced:
The expectation operator respects addition:
$E_i(f + g) = E_i f + E_i g$.
